---
title: "MXB362 Case Study ; Home-Range Size vs Traffic-Road Distance"
author: "Nicola McIlear (n11798661)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(terra)
library(ctmm)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
# install.packages("ggrepel")

checkpoint_dir <- "checkpoints"
utm_crs <- 32611

akde_test <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "akde_test.rds"))
pts_utm   <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "pts_utm.rds"))
dist_traffic_raster <- rast(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "dist_traffic_raster.tif"))

species_colors <- c("Bobcat" = "#e66101", "Coyote" = "#5e3c99")
pts_utm <- pts_utm %>%
  mutate(species = recode(individual.taxon.canonical.name,
                           "Lynx rufus" = "Bobcat", "Canis latrans" = "Coyote"))
```

## Extract traffic-road distance per fix

```{r extract-per-fix}
pts_utm$dist_to_traffic_road_m <- terra::extract(dist_traffic_raster, vect(pts_utm))[, 2]
sum(is.na(pts_utm$dist_to_traffic_road_m))            # NA count — should be small
```

## Core-area size and median distance per individual

```{r range-vs-road-data}
get_core_area_km2 <- function(id, akde_list) {
  s <- summary(akde_list[[id]], level.UD = 0.5)
  s$CI["area (square kilometers)", "est"]              # 50% core-area point estimate
}

akde_ids <- names(akde_test)
area_df <- tibble(
  individual.local.identifier = akde_ids,
  core_area_km2 = sapply(akde_ids, get_core_area_km2, akde_list = akde_test)
)

road_summary <- pts_utm %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(individual.local.identifier %in% akde_ids) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier) %>%
  summarise(median_dist_traffic_road_m = median(dist_to_traffic_road_m, na.rm = TRUE),
            species = dplyr::first(species), .groups = "drop")

plot_df <- area_df %>% left_join(road_summary, by = "individual.local.identifier")
plot_df
```

## Plot

```{r range-vs-road-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = median_dist_traffic_road_m, y = core_area_km2, colour = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = individual.local.identifier), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = species_colors, name = "Species") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Median distance to traffic-capable road (m)") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression("Core home-range area ("*km^2*")")) +
  labs(title = "Home-range size vs traffic-road distance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
